info.name: Task Bucket API
info.description:
Every HTTP endpoint exposed by the Task Bucket app (Next.js App Router, app/api/**/route.ts).

## Authentication
Most endpoints need a signed-in NextAuth session cookie.

1. Sign in through the browser at {{baseUrl}}/login
2. DevTools > Application > Cookies > copy the value of `authjs.session-token`
3. Paste it into the `sessionToken` collection variable

A collection-level pre-request script attaches it as a Cookie header on every request.

## Variables
- `baseUrl` - http://localhost:3000 (npm run dev) or http://localhost:3200 (docker compose)
- `sessionToken` - the authjs.session-token cookie value

Path variables default to REPLACE_ID - set them per request.
Request bodies list the fields each route actually reads, with placeholder values.

exec: // Attach the NextAuth session cookie when the variable is set.
